about: Twelve claims, each written four ways: a plain English statement, an English question, Tamil or Hindi, and Tanglish in the style of a WhatsApp forward. The same claim should get the same answer however it is put, and (with the claim memory on) be filed under one claim record. Written on 2026-10-12; no input repeats one from another suite. Labels are justified by the sources and follow the rules of heldout_v2.json.

claims.claim: Nana Patekar died at his home in Goa.

phrasings.input: Actor Nana Patekar has died at his home in Goa
Is it true that Nana Patekar passed away?
अभिनेता नाना पाटेकर का गोवा स्थित घर पर निधन हो गया
Nana Patekar sir passed away 😢🙏 Goa la avar veetla irundhapo nadandhuchu, RIP
